summary: Deep technical investigation into why Gemini 3.1 Pro (High) gives significantly worse results than Claude Opus 4.6 on the same prompts, despite similar benchmark scores. Covers 5 root causes: context slicing/aggressive truncation, the 'Lost in the Middle' problem, lazy default effort level, instruction following gap vs Opus, and the benchmark-vs-reality gap. Includes evidence from Reddit, developer forums, and research papers. Provides 8 practical workarounds and an updated honest model rating that accounts for these real-world failures. Concludes that benchmarks measure ceiling performance, not average daily performance, and that Gemini's real-world instruction following is measurably weaker than Opus.
